scope: Independent agent review of offline preview sheets and extra renders (no game, no browser), then fixes and re-checks.
reviewer: separate Claude agent, read-only on project files; evidence renders kept in .local/placement-fit/review-agent/

findings.description: After tilting the bow 6° forward, the lower tails sank into the back hair (about 79% of tail pixels left from behind).
findings.resolution: Second pass: reimu and reimu_face move the whole bow by the back-hair displacement at the knot and conform the tails onto the back hair (0.05 outside), removing a shear wedge at the knot that the re-review found; reimu_wasa keeps tails on the dome mapping (re-review found no wedge there). Rear tail visibility is checked at rest and in waddle, press, brace, hop and side_bend (at least 90% of the base).

findings.description: Tails went into the bare scalp (55% of tail pixels left).
findings.resolution: Second pass: tails conform 0.05 outside the scalp and its strands and take the scalp height slices, so they no longer break up or sink in waddle/press/brace (re-review finding). Rear tail pixels are 1.9 to 2.5 times the base in all sampled actions.

findings.description: At about 1000 px, a slight lip where the rounded cap meets the bangs and a thin light edge line along the side hair; not visible at normal preview size.
Skin triangles between bangs, side lock and side hair; vertical skin line at a side-hair seam.
findings.resolution: Unchanged; areas match the base model.

findings.introduced: pre-existing (old motion revision shows it too)
findings.description: Far-side blush stretches into a slanted strip at grazing angles during the puff.
Tail tops sheared by the dome mapping stuck out as wedges behind the rigid knot.

checkedFine: dome rounding on all 12 changed forms
Marisa hats seated, no gap below the brim, no hair through the hat in side_bend/hop/press/brace/taiso
scalp block no longer shows in press/brace
Marisa side locks swing without touching the brim or face during the puff
Chen cap and ears, Alice headband, shell Marisa shell
hat removal and brim carrying overview

reReview.result: No blocking issues; two minor close-range items remain.

remaining.description: In a pure side view a small red wedge (about 5% of head height) shows where the pushed-out top tail piece leaves the knot; continuous with the knot from behind and three-quarter views.

At about 1600 px, thin strand lines draw over the upper ribbon and a tiny skin notch shows on the right tail; only faintly visible at 520 px. A larger gap (0.1) with finer bending did not remove the strand lines, so the verified 0.05 setting was kept.
